correctness.rationale: The discounted pair / synergistic triple payoff expansion gives F_r(x)=r(13/30−x/60+x²/30)−1=(r/30)(x−a)(x−b); two roots lie in (0,1) exactly on the stated open parameter interval, and their stability signs follow. The T−/T+ ratio=e^{−wF} makes the exact gambler-ruin ratio of discrete potential exponentials valid, independent of the common holding factor. Euler–Maclaurin gives uniform S_N(k)=N H(k/N)+(F(k/N)−f0)/2+O(1/N). At the boundary k≈0 the numerator contribution tends to B=(1−e^{−wf0})^{−1}; at interior minimum b, the denominator mass is e^{−NwD+wf0/2}sqrt(2πN/(wd))(1+o(1)). Their relative magnitudes imply all three regimes and, uniformly for r_N→r_c, the logistic limit under NwD−(1/2)logN→z. Independent symbolic rational calculation reconfirmed payoff identity, roots, the critical parameter, and exact D'(r_c)=829/5120. An independent high-population log-domain sum at critical w=5 showed sqrt(N)h_N close to the predicted C (n=2000,10000,50000, ratios 1.064,0.984,0.979); finite checks are corroborative. The closure is NOT the original hypergraph microscopic chain.

value.rationale: Even within one deterministically bistable phase, the absorbing stochastic closure switches from exponentially unlikely full cooperation to overwhelmingly likely fixation, with polynomially small probability at equal potential heights. Quantifying the shifted logistic scale explains why deterministic coexistence diagrams cannot decide finite-population fate. Specific and mathematically meaningful despite fixed nonlinearity parameters; no microscopic hypergraph or empirical prediction claimed.

final_claim: In a defined mean-field-payoff Fermi birth-death closure for pair/triple public goods, r in (30/13,160/69) has two interior deterministic equilibria and a sharp fixation trichotomy from floor(Na). The potential gap D=A b²(3a−b)/6 crosses zero at r_c=1920/829; at equality fixation is order N^{−1/2}, and a (log N)/N benefit shift yields an explicit nontrivial logistic crossover.
limitations: Expected-payoff closure is not a stochastic representation of source finite hypergraph; no inference about source microscopic absorption is made.
